{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The War on Poverty has been fought for 50 years and poverty is winning.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"We have been fighting the War on Poverty for 50 years and poverty is winning."},
{"claim_text":"The social safety net is designed to help people born into or falling into poverty.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"Our social safety net — about 80 separate means-tested programs costing over $1 trillion every year — is designed to help people born into or falling into poverty."},
{"claim_text":"The social safety net consists of about 80 separate means-tested programs.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"Our social safety net — about 80 separate means-tested programs costing over $1 trillion every year — is designed to help people born into or falling into poverty."},
{"claim_text":"The social safety net costs over $1 trillion every year.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"Our social safety net — about 80 separate means-tested programs costing over $1 trillion every year — is designed to help people born into or falling into poverty."},
{"claim_text":"The social safety net rarely lifts people out of poverty.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"It rarely lifts them out."},
{"claim_text":"Apologists for the social safety net judge success by the amount of money spent to keep people in the system.","claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence":"Its apologists judge success by the amount of money spent to keep people in the system."},
{"claim_text":"Judging success by the amount of money spent to keep people in the system is a cruel measurement.","claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence":"That is a cruel measurement."},
{"claim_text":"Republicans propose to evaluate a poverty program by whether it actually reduces poverty and increases the personal independence of its participants.","claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence":"Republicans propose to evaluate a poverty program by whether it actually reduces poverty and increases the personal independence of its participants."},
{"claim_text":"Intergenerational poverty has persisted and worsened since 1966.","claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"The results are damning: intergenerational poverty has persisted and worsened since 1966."}],
